title: 俗世凡尘 第5章 绝脉俗世凡尘 第6章 医道上

陆多福的到来，让南宫月很是高兴，她长到十多岁，总算有了个年纪相仿的师弟为伴。陆多福虽做过乞丐，却极为懂事，家里的活总是抢着干，兼之他对长辈极为孝敬，深得南宫修一家喜爱。
最欣喜的是白云溪，她教陆多福识字。没想到陆多福悟性惊人，不管是生僻字还是经史子集，一学即会，并融会贯通。从开始读书短短三个月后，书香门第出身的白云溪深感无力，实在没什么可教的了。
南宫修知道此事后，也是很高兴。看来他眼光不错，收了个好徒弟。要知道武道一途，悟性极为重要。以南宫修看来，陆多福悟性奇高，心性也不错。只要身体资质不是特别差，将来前途不可限量。
陆多福也是无比期待，师父说自己很好，那铁定不会骗人。等学了本事，那一定要行侠仗义，做一个顶天立地的大英雄。还有，陆多福还要回去钱小胖面前好好嘚瑟一番，谁让这小子平日里那么狂的。
在一个风和日丽的早晨，碧秀峰上，南宫修拿来基本功法秘籍让陆多福当面读出来。在陆多福一字不差的念完后，并且能说个大概意思，南宫修也就确认他能看懂了，于是开始教他修炼。
修炼的第一步，就是炼气。修炼之人学会引天地灵气入体，在体内运行周天，再转化为灵力，存储在体内。等练习娴熟后，再修炼一些功法，加速灵力的获取，迅速提升修为。最后练习一些武技，学会在战斗中使用灵力。以上就是修炼的整个过程。
炼气之法都是浅显易懂，各宗各门基本上都是一致，除了一些不走寻常路的，比如鬼修，邪修之类的。
以陆多福的悟性，不必细说，一听就懂。所以南宫修教会他就匆匆走了，毕竟他身为一派掌门，也挺忙的。于是碧秀峰顶只留下陆多福一个人修炼，峰顶灵气充沛，最是适合修炼。
按南宫修的说法，炼气之法虽简单重复，但要快速建功，却是不行的。主要是没有修炼经验的人，刚刚踏入此道，万事不可操之过急，要细细体会灵气在体内的运行。不可强行运气，以免气岔玄关，走火入魔。
碧秀峰顶微风习习，令人神清气爽。陆多福盘膝坐下，回味着南宫修方才的话，照着炼气之法修炼，他每一步都进行的小心翼翼。毕竟师父说过，走火入魔会让修炼之人元气大伤，严重者甚至会对身体造成不可逆转的永久性损伤。
“呃……”陆多福一声痛哼。尽管他已经很小心了，可还是出了问题。当体内灵气运行到最后，快要汇入丹田时，居然感觉气息明显受阻，而且两肋之间隐隐作痛。
陆多福吓了一跳，这症状像极了师父说的气岔，幸好修炼处于初级阶段，造成伤害不深，只是两肋之间痛了一下，就没什么感觉了。
当下他用心对照了师父留下的纸帛，将上面所记炼气之法及附注详细过了数遍。陆多福惊呆当场，他确定他没练错。可问题出在哪呢？
练了一整天，什么也没练成。陆多福带着满腹疑问，悻悻下了山顶。他本想找师父问一问，可很不巧，早上师父说过，有个门派的长老的儿子成亲，邀请师父去做客。所以师父师娘带着师姐去做客去了，那地方很远，要小半月才能回来。南宫修本来想带陆多福去的，可对于一个憧憬着美好未来的武道新人来说，修炼远比喜宴上的美味佳肴更有吸引力，所以陆多福拒绝了。现在偌大的碧秀峰，只剩他一人。
接下来的几日，陆多福每日都去碧秀峰顶修炼，他前后尝试了上千次，可都是同样的结果。气息一旦运行到双肋之间时，总会疼痛难忍，且越发加重。不过陆多福并非没有收获，他现在的运气极其熟练，可以控制气息在体内任意变幻，除了不能汇入丹田。
“师父他们已经去了半个月，算算日子该回来了吧。”陆多福望着空荡荡的小院喃喃自语。陆多福随即往峰顶走，师父要回来了，那得抓紧修炼，争取修炼出点成果来。毕竟师父临走前说过，让陆多福不要偷懒，努力修炼，他回来可是要验收的。
希望能解开气息阻滞这个症状吧！否则要是修炼半个月没一点成果，那岂不是显得自己很没用。陆多福一边想一边盘膝运气，用起功来。练了不到半个时辰，陆多福忽然胸口一阵剧痛，随即一口血喷出，倒地不省人事。
……
“师叔，如何？”云隐门云药堂的药房里，南宫修问道。

“此子体内气息古怪，与常人不一般。老夫行医多年，从未见过这种异状。”一个灰衣老者收回了搭在陆多福脉搏处的手，摇头道。
陆多福晕倒之后，如果无人相救，恐有性命之忧。关键时刻，南宫修三人回来了，并且在山顶找到了他，就赶紧把他送落霞峰的云药堂来。
云药堂给陆多福诊治这个灰衣老者姓温，论辈分还是南宫修的师叔。他修为虽然不高，但医术极为了得，在沧澜州一带很有名气。若是他都没法治好陆多福，那就麻烦了。
白云溪焦急地问道：“温师叔，您老也不能断定是什么病症吗？”
“师祖爷，请您一定要治好小福子，他可不能有事。”南宫月声音不大，但明显带了哭腔。
南宫修爱怜地摸了摸南宫月地额头道：“月儿莫急，师祖爷医术高超，多福他不会有事的。”南宫修朝老者行了一礼道：“师叔，拜托您老了。”

Lu Duofu's arrival made Nangong Yue very happy. When she was more than ten years old, she finally had a junior brother of similar age to accompany her. Although Lu Duofu had been a beggar, he was extremely sensible and always competed for the work at home. In addition, he was extremely filial to his elders and was deeply loved by Nangong Xiu's family.
The happiest person was Bai Yunxi, who taught Lu Duofu how to read. Unexpectedly, Lu Duofu's understanding was astonishing. Whether it was rare characters or a collection of classics and history, he could master it as soon as he learned it and integrated it into everything. Just three months after he started studying, Bai Yunxi, who came from a scholarly family, felt deeply powerless and had nothing to teach him.
Nangong Xiu was also very happy after knowing this. It seems that he has good vision and has gained a good apprentice. To know the path of martial arts, understanding is extremely important. From Nangong Xiu's point of view, Lu Duofu has a very high level of understanding and a good character. As long as your physical qualifications are not particularly bad, your future prospects are limitless.
Lu Duofu is also looking forward to it extremely much. If the master says that he is very good, he will definitely not lie. After you learn the skills, you must act chivalrously and become a hero who stands upright. Also, Lu Duofu wanted to go back and have a good chat in front of Qian Xiaopang. Who makes this kid so crazy on weekdays?
On a sunny morning on Bixiu Peak, Nangong Xiu brought the basic skills secret book and asked Lu Duofu to read it in person. After Lu Duofu read it word for word and was able to give a general idea, Nangong Xiu confirmed that he could understand it and began to teach him how to practice.
The first step in cultivation is to refine Qi. Cultivators learn to attract the spiritual energy of heaven and earth into their bodies, circulate it around the body, and then transform it into spiritual power and store it in their bodies. After you become proficient in practice, you can practice some exercises to speed up the acquisition of spiritual power and quickly improve your cultivation level. Finally, practice some martial arts and learn to use your spiritual power in battle. The above is the entire process of cultivation.
The methods of refining qi are all simple and easy to understand, and all sects and sects are basically the same, except for some who take unconventional paths, such as ghost cultivators, evil cultivators and the like.
With Lu Duofu's understanding, he doesn't need to explain in detail, he can understand it as soon as he hears it. So Nangong Xiujiu left in a hurry. After all, as the leader of a sect, he was quite busy. So Lu Duofu was left to practice alone on the top of Bixiu Peak. The peak was full of spiritual energy and was most suitable for practice.
According to Nangong Xiu, although the method of refining Qi is simple and repetitive, it is not enough to quickly build Qi. It is mainly for people who have no cultivation experience and have just stepped into this path. They should not rush into anything and should carefully appreciate the movement of spiritual energy in the body. Don't force your luck, otherwise you will be distracted by your anger and go crazy.
The breeze blowing from the top of Bixiu Peak is refreshing. Lu Duofu sat down cross-legged, recalling Nangong Xiu's words just now, practicing according to the Qi refining method, and he took every step carefully. After all, Master has said that going too far will severely damage a cultivator's vitality, and in severe cases may even cause irreversible and permanent damage to the body.
"Uh..." Lu Duofu groaned in pain. Even though he was careful, something went wrong. When the spiritual energy in the body reaches the end and is about to merge into the Dantian, I actually feel that my breath is obviously blocked, and there is a dull pain between my ribs.
Lu Duofu was startled. This symptom was very similar to what the master said about Qi Cha. Fortunately, the cultivation was in the initial stage, so the damage was not serious. It was just a pain between the two ribs, and he felt nothing at all.
At the moment, he carefully compared the paper left by his master, and read the Qi refining method and notes written on it several times in detail. Lu Duofu was stunned on the spot. He was sure that he had practiced correctly. But what's the problem?
I practiced all day and accomplished nothing. Full of questions, Lu Duofu descended from the top of the mountain in frustration. He originally wanted to ask the master, but unfortunately, the master said in the morning that the son of an elder of a sect got married and invited the master to be a guest. So the master and his wife took the senior sister to visit. The place was far away and it would take half a month to come back. Nangong Xiu originally wanted to take Lu Duofu there, but for a new martial artist who was looking forward to a bright future, practicingIt was far more attractive than the delicacies at the wedding banquet, so Lu Duofu refused. Now he was the only one left in the huge Bixiu Peak.
In the next few days, Lu Duofu went to the top of Bixiu Peak to practice every day. He tried thousands of times, but with the same result. Once the breath travels between the ribs, the pain will always be unbearable and get worse. However, Lu Duofu is not without gains. He is now extremely skilled in luck and can control his breath to change at will in his body, except that it cannot flow into his Dantian.
"Master and the others have been gone for half a month. It's time to come back." Lu Duofu muttered to himself, looking at the empty courtyard. Lu Duofu immediately walked to the top of the mountain. Master was coming back, so he had to practice hard and strive for some results. After all, the master said before leaving that Lu Duofu should not be lazy and practice hard, and he would have to accept it when he came back.
I hope this symptom of breath blockage can be solved! Otherwise, if you practice for half a month without any results, wouldn't it mean that you are useless? Lu Duofu thought about it while crossing his legs to try his luck. After practicing for less than half an hour, Lu Duofu suddenly felt a sharp pain in his chest, then a mouthful of blood spurted out, and he fell to the ground unconscious.
…
"Uncle Master, how are you?" Nangong Xiu asked in the pharmacy of Yunyinmen Yunyao Hall.
"The aura in this child's body is weird, not ordinary. I have been practicing medicine for many years and have never seen anything like this before." An old man in gray clothes withdrew his hand from Lu Duofu's pulse point and shook his head.
After Lu Duofu fainted, if no one came to save him, his life might be in danger. At the critical moment, Nangong Xiu and the others came back and found him on the top of the mountain, so they quickly sent him to the Yunyao Hall in Luoxia Peak.
Yun Yaotang treated Lu Duofu. This old man in gray clothes was named Wen. In terms of seniority, he was Nangong Xiu's uncle. Although his cultivation level is not high, his medical skills are extremely good and he is very famous in Canglan Prefecture. If he couldn't cure Lu Duofu, it would be troublesome.
Bai Yunxi asked anxiously: "Uncle Wen, can't you tell what the disease is?"
"Master, please heal Xiao Fuzi. Nothing will happen to him." Nangong Yue's voice was not loud, but she was obviously crying.
Nangong Xiu touched Nangong Yuedi's forehead lovingly and said: "Yue'er, don't worry, my master has superb medical skills. Fortunately, he will be fine." Nangong Xiu saluted the old man and said: "Uncle, I beg you to be old."
